title: IPFS MCP contract: shared definitions
description: Value types shared by every tool schema. Tool schemas reference these by relative $ref; contract.BundleSchema inlines them for MCP clients.

Cid.description: A CID in any multibase Kubo accepts (CIDv0 base58btc or CIDv1, for example bafy...).

ContentPath.description: A bare CID, a CID with a sub-path, or an /ipfs/, /ipns/ or /ipld/ content path. No segment may be . or .., so path cleaning cannot change the namespace or the root a caller checked (R13 security L2).

MfsPath.description: An absolute path in the node's Mutable File System (MFS). Paths under /ipfs/, /ipns/ and /ipld/ are rejected: the daemon would resolve them as content paths, letting a closed-world MFS tool read from the network. Copy content into MFS with mfs_cp, whose source is an MfsCopySource. A segment equal to . or .. is rejected, and so is an empty first segment (//): path cleaning would otherwise turn /a/../ipns/x or //ipfs/x into a content path (R13 security L2). Bare /ipfs, /ipns and /ipld name ordinary MFS entries.

MfsCopySource.description: An MfsPath, or an /ipfs/<cid>[/path] content path. /ipns/ and /ipld/ sources are rejected, and no segment may be . or .. (R13 security L2).

KeyName.description: The local name of a keystore key, for example self.

PeerId.description: A libp2p peer ID (base58btc or CIDv1 libp2p-key).

IpnsName.description: An IPNS name (libp2p-key CID or DNSLink domain), with or without the /ipns/ prefix. The name may not start with a dot, and no sub-path segment may be . or .. (R13 security L2).

Duration.description: A Go duration string, for example 30s or 24h.

Encoding.description: How content bytes are carried in a JSON string.

Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as next_cursor by a previous call. Clients must not parse it.

Limit.description: Maximum number of items in one page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Present only when has_more is true.

PageInfo.description: Cursor pagination metadata for list tools.

uri.description: An ipfs:// or ipns:// resource URI readable with resources/read.

mime_type.description: Detected or declared media type, when known.

ResourceRef.description: A resource the client reads separately instead of receiving it inline (sent as an MCP resource_link content block as well).

Warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about work that follows the tool's own effect, which has already succeeded: for example index entries kept because the pin check or the vector store failed. Absent when there is nothing to report. The tool's result is unchanged by them.

ConfirmToken.description: Two-step confirmation token from a confirmation_required result: a binding handle, not consent. Accepted only after its pending confirmation was approved by elicitation or a human-presence resolver; single-use, 120-second TTL, bound to the session, principal, tool and canonical arguments. Never issued to or accepted from principals of kind a2a or uar.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error code. Shared by every tool, transport and endpoint. The list grows additively: a client treats an unknown code as an error and uses retryable alone to decide whether to retry. Endpoint codes (ADR-0004, Round 7 amendment): session_busy (another run is in progress on the same thread, session or A2A context; retryable once it ends), failed_precondition (the target is not in a state that accepts the request: an open interrupt, a thread at its message cap, an A2A task in a terminal state; not retryable unchanged), resource_exhausted (a server-wide cap such as the session limit is reached; retryable, with Retry-After on HTTP).

ToolError.description: structuredContent of every tool result with isError true.

message.description: Human-readable message. Never includes credentials or content bytes.

retryable.description: True when the same call may succeed later without changes.

details.description: Code-specific details, for example the RPC command that failed or the missing egress host.

confirmation.description: Present only when code is confirmation_required or confirmation_pending.
